# Bioma Health

> Bioma Health offers science-backed probiotics, synbiotics, and microbiome wellness solutions designed to optimize gut health, hormone balance, and overall wellness.

Bioma Health specializes in personalized probiotic formulations and educational content addressing gut-brain axis connections, feminine health, stress management, and metabolic wellness. The platform combines e-commerce, clinical guidance, and evidence-based health education to support microbiome optimization across diverse health concerns.
